# Meter

Show an exact bounded measurement and classify it against quality thresholds.

## Usage

### Threshold zones

Classify the value as optimum, suboptimal, or even less good from explicit thresholds.

<ComponentExample component="meter" scenario="threshold-zones" title="Threshold zones" description="Classify the value as optimum, suboptimal, or even less good from explicit thresholds." :index="0" />

### Exact decimal

Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion.

<ComponentExample component="meter" scenario="exact-decimal" title="Exact decimal" description="Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion." :index="1" />

### Equal bounds

Represent the only valid value when the minimum and maximum are equal.

<ComponentExample component="meter" scenario="degenerate-range" title="Equal bounds" description="Represent the only valid value when the minimum and maximum are equal." :index="2" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>None</kbd> | The range display is read-only and defines no keyboard interaction. |

## Accessibility

The named read-only meter exposes its minimum, maximum, current value, and formatted value text without inventing ARIA threshold attributes.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/meter/) for the host accessibility contract.
